chunks: And from his words (peace be upon him), it is narrated from him that he said:
He [Ali] was at the burial of the Lady of Women, Fatimah (peace be upon her), addressing the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) at his grave as if he were conversing with him:
ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali say to the Prophet at the grave of Fatimah?
ai.summary: This narration captures Imam Ali’s (peace be upon him) intimate supplication at the grave of Fatimah al-Zahra (peace be upon her), reflecting the deep emotional and spiritual bond between the Ahl al-Bayt. It highlights the Shia tradition of viewing the Prophet’s grave as a living presence, where Ali addresses him not merely as a historical figure but as a spiritual guide, mirroring the Prophet’s own dialogues with the divine. This moment underscores the continuity of revelation and leadership (Imamate) within the Prophet’s household.

en.sayed-ali-raza: What Amīr al-mu’minīn said on the occasion of the burial of Sayyidatu’n-nisā’ (Supreme lady) Fāṭimah (as) while addressing the Holy Prophet (sw) at his grave.
